# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Az EasyEffects által használt DSP könyvtárak (forrásból, statikusan)
#   LSP (lsp-common-lib, lsp-dsp-lib, lsp-lltl-lib, lsp-runtime-lib, lsp-dsp-units) - LGPL-3.0+
#   Calf Bass Enhancer                                                             - LGPL-2.1+
#   libbs2b                                                                        - MIT
#   SpeexDSP resampler                                                             - BSD
#   zita-convolver (Ardour hordozható változata)                                   - GPL-3.0+
#   FFTW3 (single precision)                                                       - GPL-2.0+
# A saját fordítási kapcsolóik szerint épülnek (nincs -ffast-math).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

set(TP ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

if(MSVC)
    set(AQ_TP_NOWARN /w)
else()
    set(AQ_TP_NOWARN -w)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- LSP
set(LSP ${TP}/lsp)
file(GLOB_RECURSE AQ_LSP_COMMON  ${LSP}/lsp-common-lib/src/main/*.cpp)
file(GLOB_RECURSE AQ_LSP_LLTL    ${LSP}/lsp-lltl-lib/src/main/*.cpp)
file(GLOB_RECURSE AQ_LSP_RUNTIME ${LSP}/lsp-runtime-lib/src/main/*.cpp)
# libsndfile-függő részek (hangfájl I/O) nem kellenek
list(FILTER AQ_LSP_RUNTIME EXCLUDE REGEX "/mm/|fmt/lspc/util/audio.cpp")
file(GLOB_RECURSE AQ_LSP_UNITS   ${LSP}/lsp-dsp-units/src/main/*.cpp)
list(FILTER AQ_LSP_UNITS EXCLUDE REGEX "/sampling/|/3d/")

set(DSPDIR ${LSP}/lsp-dsp-lib/src/main)
set(AQ_LSP_DSP ${DSPDIR}/dsp.cpp ${DSPDIR}/generic/generic.cpp)
set(CARCH ${LSP}/lsp-common-lib/src/arch)
list(APPEND AQ_LSP_COMMON ${CARCH}/generic/generic.cpp)

string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}" AQ_CPU)
if(APPLE AND CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
    # macOS-en a gépétől eltérő architektúrára is fordítható (pl. arm64 gépen x86_64); egyszerre egy szelet,
    # az univerzális alkalmazást a két külön fordításból a lipo egyesíti
    list(LENGTH CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AQ_NARCH)
    if(AQ_NARCH GREATER 1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES: egyszerre egy architektúra (az univerzális bináris lipo-val készül)")
    endif()
    string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES}" AQ_CPU)
endif()
if(AQ_CPU MATCHES "x86_64|amd64|i.86|x86")
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_COMMON ${CARCH}/x86/x86.cpp ${CARCH}/x86/sse.cpp ${CARCH}/x86/avx.cpp ${CARCH}/x86/avx512.cpp)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${CARCH}/x86/sse.cpp    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mmmx;-msse")
        set_source_files_properties(${CARCH}/x86/avx.cpp    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx;-mvzeroupper")
        set_source_files_properties(${CARCH}/x86/avx512.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx512f;-mavx512vl")
    endif()
    set(AQ_X86_SRC sse sse2 sse3 sse4 avx avx_nz avx2 avx512)
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_DSP ${DSPDIR}/x86/x86.cpp)
    foreach(s ${AQ_X86_SRC})
        list(APPEND AQ_LSP_DSP ${DSPDIR}/x86/${s}.cpp)
    endforeach()
    if(NOT MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/sse.cpp    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mmmx;-msse")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/sse2.cpp   PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mmmx;-msse;-msse2")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/sse3.cpp   PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mmmx;-msse;-msse2;-msse3;-mssse3")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/sse4.cpp   PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mmmx;-msse;-msse2;-msse3;-mssse3;-msse4;-msse4a;-msse4.1;-msse4.2")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/avx.cpp    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx;-mvzeroupper")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/avx_nz.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx;-mno-vzeroupper")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/avx2.cpp   PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx;-mvzeroupper;-mavx2")
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/x86/avx512.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx512f;-mavx512vl")
    endif()
elseif(AQ_CPU MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_DSP ${DSPDIR}/aarch64/aarch64.cpp ${DSPDIR}/aarch64/asimd.cpp)
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_COMMON ${CARCH}/aarch64/aarch64.cpp ${CARCH}/aarch64/asimd.cpp)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/aarch64/asimd.cpp ${CARCH}/aarch64/asimd.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-march=armv8-a+simd")
    endif()
elseif(AQ_CPU MATCHES "arm")
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_DSP ${DSPDIR}/arm/arm.cpp ${DSPDIR}/arm/neon-d32.cpp)
    list(APPEND AQ_LSP_COMMON ${CARCH}/arm/arm.cpp ${CARCH}/arm/neon-d32.cpp)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${DSPDIR}/arm/neon-d32.cpp ${CARCH}/arm/neon-d32.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mfpu=neon-vfpv4")
    endif()
endif()

add_library(aq_lsp STATIC ${AQ_LSP_COMMON} ${AQ_LSP_LLTL} ${AQ_LSP_RUNTIME} ${AQ_LSP_UNITS} ${AQ_LSP_DSP})
target_include_directories(aq_lsp SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${LSP}/lsp-common-lib/include ${LSP}/lsp-dsp-lib/include ${LSP}/lsp-lltl-lib/include
    ${LSP}/lsp-runtime-lib/include ${LSP}/lsp-dsp-units/include)
target_compile_definitions(aq_lsp PUBLIC
    LSP_COMMON_LIB_BUILTIN LSP_DSP_LIB_BUILTIN LSP_LLTL_LIB_BUILTIN LSP_RUNTIME_LIB_BUILTIN LSP_DSP_UNITS_BUILTIN
    USE_LSP_COMMON_LIB USE_LSP_DSP_LIB USE_LSP_LLTL_LIB USE_LSP_RUNTIME_LIB)
set_target_properties(aq_lsp PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(aq_lsp PRIVATE -O2 -fvisibility=hidden -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti
                           -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
endif()
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(aq_lsp PUBLIC mpr shlwapi ole32 uuid)
else()
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(aq_lsp PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
    if(APPLE)
        target_link_libraries(aq_lsp PUBLIC iconv)   # macOS-en az iconv külön könyvtár (Linuxon a libc része)
    endif()
endif()
if(APPLE AND AQ_CPU MATCHES "x86_64|amd64")
    # Az LSP x86 assembly-sablonjai az LLVM assemblerrel csak javítva fordulnak (részletek: macos/lsp_x86_asm.sh)
    set_target_properties(aq_lsp PROPERTIES CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../macos/lsp_x86_asm.sh)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Calf (csak fejlécek)
add_library(aq_calf INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(aq_calf SYSTEM INTERFACE ${TP}/calf)
target_compile_definitions(aq_calf INTERFACE _USE_MATH_DEFINES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- libbs2b
add_library(aq_bs2b STATIC ${TP}/libbs2b/bs2b.c)
target_include_directories(aq_bs2b SYSTEM PUBLIC ${TP}/libbs2b)
set_target_properties(aq_bs2b PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_options(aq_bs2b PRIVATE ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
if(NOT WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(aq_bs2b PUBLIC m)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SpeexDSP resampler
add_library(aq_speex STATIC ${TP}/speexdsp/libspeexdsp/resample.c)
target_include_directories(aq_speex SYSTEM PUBLIC ${TP}/speexdsp/include)
target_include_directories(aq_speex PRIVATE ${TP}/speexdsp/libspeexdsp)
target_compile_definitions(aq_speex PRIVATE FLOATING_POINT EXPORT=)
if(AQ_CPU MATCHES "x86_64|amd64")
    target_compile_definitions(aq_speex PRIVATE USE_SSE USE_SSE2)
elseif(AQ_CPU MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
    target_compile_definitions(aq_speex PRIVATE USE_NEON)
endif()
set_target_properties(aq_speex PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_options(aq_speex PRIVATE ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
if(NOT WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(aq_speex PUBLIC m)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- FFTW3 (float)
# Linuxon a rendszer fftw3f csomagja; Windowson (vagy ha megadják) forrásból statikusan.
set(AQULIFY_FFTW_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "FFTW 3.3.x forrásmappa (üres: rendszer fftw3f)")
if(AQULIFY_FFTW_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(ENABLE_FLOAT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_THREADS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    if(AQ_CPU MATCHES "x86_64|amd64")
        set(ENABLE_SSE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(ENABLE_SSE2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(ENABLE_AVX ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(ENABLE_AVX2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endif()
    set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
    add_subdirectory(${AQULIFY_FFTW_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fftw EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    target_compile_options(fftw3f PRIVATE ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
    if(WIN32)
        # Windowson nincs memalign/posix_memalign (FFTW: --with-our-malloc)
        target_compile_definitions(fftw3f PRIVATE WITH_OUR_MALLOC=1)
    endif()
    set_target_properties(fftw3f PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    add_library(aq_fftw INTERFACE)
    target_link_libraries(aq_fftw INTERFACE fftw3f)
    target_include_directories(aq_fftw SYSTEM INTERFACE ${AQULIFY_FFTW_SOURCE_DIR}/api)
else()
    find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
    pkg_check_modules(FFTW3F REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET fftw3f)
    add_library(aq_fftw INTERFACE)
    target_link_libraries(aq_fftw INTERFACE PkgConfig::FFTW3F)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- zita-convolver
add_library(aq_zita STATIC ${TP}/zita-convolver/zita-convolver.cc)
target_include_directories(aq_zita SYSTEM PUBLIC ${TP}/zita-convolver)
target_compile_definitions(aq_zita PUBLIC LIBZCONVOLVER_STATIC)
set_target_properties(aq_zita PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_options(aq_zita PRIVATE ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
target_link_libraries(aq_zita PUBLIC aq_fftw)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(aq_zita PUBLIC pthread)
else()
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(aq_zita PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- RNNoise (Magic Touch: beszéd zajcsökkentés)
# A kód a tárolóban van (third_party/rnnoise), a betanított modell (src/rnnoise_data.c, 29 MB) nincs:
#   -DAQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR=<mappa>  a rnnoise_data.c és rnnoise_data.h mappája (pl. az Ubuntu
#                                        rnnoise_0.2+ds.orig.tar.xz csomag rnnoise-0.2/src mappája);
#   ennek hiányában Linuxon a rendszer librnnoise csomagja (pkg-config: rnnoise), ha van.
# Egyik sem: az aq_rnnoise üres, és a Magic Touch a beszédnél is a saját, sávonkénti zajcsökkentést használja.
set(AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Az RNNoise modell (rnnoise_data.c / .h) mappája")
add_library(aq_rnnoise INTERFACE)
if(AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR)
    if(NOT EXISTS ${AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR}/rnnoise_data.c OR NOT EXISTS ${AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR}/rnnoise_data.h)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR: nincs benne rnnoise_data.c és rnnoise_data.h")
    endif()
    set(RNN ${TP}/rnnoise/src)
    add_library(aq_rnnoise_impl STATIC
        ${RNN}/denoise.c ${RNN}/rnn.c ${RNN}/pitch.c ${RNN}/kiss_fft.c ${RNN}/celt_lpc.c ${RNN}/nnet.c
        ${RNN}/nnet_default.c ${RNN}/parse_lpcnet_weights.c ${RNN}/rnnoise_tables.c
        ${AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR}/rnnoise_data.c)
    target_include_directories(aq_rnnoise_impl SYSTEM PUBLIC ${TP}/rnnoise/include)
    target_include_directories(aq_rnnoise_impl PRIVATE ${RNN} ${AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR})
    target_compile_options(aq_rnnoise_impl PRIVATE ${AQ_TP_NOWARN})
    set_target_properties(aq_rnnoise_impl PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_link_libraries(aq_rnnoise_impl PRIVATE m)
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(aq_rnnoise INTERFACE aq_rnnoise_impl)
    target_compile_definitions(aq_rnnoise INTERFACE AQ_HAVE_RNNOISE=1)
    message(STATUS "RNNoise: beépítve (modell: ${AQULIFY_RNNOISE_MODEL_DIR})")
elseif(NOT WIN32)
    find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
    if(PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(RNNOISE QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET rnnoise)
    endif()
    if(RNNOISE_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(aq_rnnoise INTERFACE PkgConfig::RNNOISE)
        target_compile_definitions(aq_rnnoise INTERFACE AQ_HAVE_RNNOISE=1)
        message(STATUS "RNNoise: a rendszer csomagja (${RNNOISE_VERSION})")
    else()
        message(STATUS "RNNoise: nincs (a beszéd zajcsökkentése a saját, sávonkénti módszerrel)")
    endif()
else()
    message(STATUS "RNNoise: nincs (a beszéd zajcsökkentése a saját, sávonkénti módszerrel)")
endif()
